small_guidance:
- The shared-memory blow-up comes from `BLOCK_OC=128`, `BLOCK_IC=64`, `BLOCK_W=64` with `num_stages=3` — the `(BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_W)=128x64` accumulator plus the `w_vals` 64x128 tile and `x_vals` 64x64 tile, multiplied by 3 pipeline stages, exceeds 100KB. Drop `num_stages` to 2 and shrink `BLOCK_W` to 32 (or `BLOCK_OC` to 64 looped over OC) as a first quick fix.
- Add a `triton.autotune` over `{BLOCK_W: 16/32/64, BLOCK_OC: 32/64/128, num_warps: 4/8, num_stages: 2}` keyed on `(OC, OW)`, so the launcher picks a config that fits in 100KB.
- Hoist the `b_vec` initialization out of the `oh` loop (currently re-broadcast every iteration); it's an `inf`-masked constant tile that can be re-used.
large_guidance:
- Restructure the kernel so the OC dimension is the GEMM-reduction axis of `tl.dot` rather than a tile carried in the accumulator. Per `(n, oh, ow_tile)`, you only need the min over OC of the conv output — you can compute conv as `dot(W[ic,oc,kh,kw], x[ic,...])` with shape `(BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_W)` once per `(oh, kh, kw)`, then immediately `tl.min(..., axis=0)` and accumulate a `(BLOCK_W,)` running min. But since min is not distributive over the kh/kw sum, you must finish the full conv at this `oh` before taking min — so keep the `(BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_W)` tile but tile OC in chunks of 32 with an outer loop, keeping shared-memory footprint small.
- Alternatively, fuse the `oh`-axis sum into the kernel as a single program-per-`(n, ow_tile)` (current design) but stream OC: outer loop over OC tiles of 32, for each OC tile compute the conv tile for the entire column of `oh` values into registers, take min along OC tile, keep a running per-`ow` min across OC tiles, then sum over oh. This removes the dependency between BLOCK_OC and shared memory pressure.
- For ConvTranspose with stride=2, only ~1/4 of `(kh,kw)` positions are valid per output pixel; consider the scatter-add formulation (one program per input element, scatter its `IC×OC` outer-product contribution into output) — but since min-over-OC must see the full sum, gather is still the right structure. Just shrink tiles and tile OC.
